user.title: Connect UteamUP
user.description: Use a tenant API key that is not MCP-enabled. Create it in UteamUP under Tenant Management > API Keys and give it a role with the permissions Home Assistant should have. The key acts as the person who created it, so they need those permissions too.

data_description.url: Keep the default address unless your company uses another UteamUP environment.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a local development server with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to UteamUP again
reauth_confirm.description: UteamUP no longer accepts the saved API key. It may have been rotated, disabled or expired. Enter a key for the same company.

error.invalid_auth: UteamUP rejected the API key or secret.
error.mcp_key_not_allowed: This key is MCP-enabled. Create a key with MCP access turned off for Home Assistant.
error.plan_required: The company's UteamUP plan is not active yet.
error.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach UteamUP at that address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_url: Enter the full API address, starting with https.

abort.already_configured: This UteamUP company is already connected.
abort.wrong_tenant: That key belongs to a different UteamUP company.

data.assignee_guid: Only list work orders assigned to (user GUID)
data.enable_telemetry: Send energy readings to dedicated IoT

data_description.enable_webhooks: Needs the Enterprise plan and a public Home Assistant URL, such as Home Assistant Cloud. Polling continues either way.
data_description.assignee_guid: Leave empty to list every open work order.
data_description.enable_telemetry: Optional. Review existing lights or sockets and their W/cumulative-kWh sources next. Requires an already active, healthy dedicated tenant endpoint. Turning this off stops delivery and keeps the local queue.

telemetry_devices.title: Choose existing IoT devices
telemetry_devices.description: Select the existing UteamUP devices to configure. Each must already be linked to its asset and physical MAC address. Unchecked devices stop capturing; their queued readings remain retained for review. This does not provision infrastructure or purchase anything. Leave energy devices empty to configure only Deco network telemetry.

data_description.retry_quarantined: Use only after fixing a rejected key, endpoint or meter configuration. Retries preserve the original payload and UUIDs. A changed physical mapping must be restored before its older readings can be retried.

telemetry_mapping.title: Review {device} ({position}/{count})
telemetry_mapping.description: Choose this device's light or switch, its power source and its cumulative energy source. Only sources belonging to this physical device are shown. Select whether power is estimated or measured by the WiZ socket. Use this device's own ingestion key.

data_description.power_basis: Measured requires the WiZ socket power sensor and its own cumulative energy sensor or Integral helper. Existing light estimates remain estimated.
data_description.estimate_profile: Leave blank for measured socket readings. For estimates, use the same version shown by the HA estimate source, for example demo-linear-v1. Estimates remain approximate and adjustable; they are not electricity billing measurements.
data_description.device_key: Paste the narrow ingestion key for this device. Leave blank to keep its previously saved key. Keys are never prefilled or included in diagnostics.

telemetry_confirm.title: Enable energy delivery
telemetry_confirm.description: Enable the reviewed mappings for {count} devices to {endpoint}. Samples are taken every 60 seconds and retain the selected measured or estimated reading type. Unavailable devices produce no new readings or heartbeat. Already queued observations can replay later with their original timestamps. The bounded queue retains rejected data and reports delivery failures separately from device availability. Submit to continue to optional Deco network telemetry, or close this dialog to keep the existing settings.

telemetry_network_devices.title: Choose Deco network devices
telemetry_network_devices.description: Optionally select TP-Link Deco routers whose tracker MAC matches the existing UteamUP device. Energy mappings are kept separately. Leave empty to save without network telemetry.

telemetry_network_mapping.title: Review Deco telemetry for {device} ({position}/{count})
telemetry_network_mapping.description: Choose the Deco tracker and its download, upload, client-count, internet and router sources. Rates are those reported by the Deco integration, not a packet capture or independent WAN measurement. The client inventory separately counts the whole network. Use the gateway device ingestion key.

data_description.device_key: Paste the narrow ingestion key for this router. Leave blank to keep its previously saved key. Keys are never prefilled or included in diagnostics.

telemetry_network_confirm.title: Enable Deco network delivery
telemetry_network_confirm.description: Save {count} Deco gateway mappings and {clients} client links to {endpoint}. For each linked asset, add the tenant custom Deco client telemetry type and any missing download (kB/s), upload (kB/s) and connected (0/1) meters. Keep existing types and energy readings. This requires Asset.View/Update and AssetType.View/Create. The gateway sends readings every 60 seconds, retaining the source observation time; unavailable or old sources supply no new client readings. Offline clients supply only connected=0. The inventory includes every discovered client; the selected router count and whole-network count remain separate. Submit to apply. Closing keeps the previous settings. If a request fails, already added types/meters remain and retry reuses them.

telemetry_clients.title: Link Deco clients to assets (optional)
telemetry_clients.description: The client inventory includes local IP, MAC, connection, reported download and upload. Select clients to add meter readings to existing assets. Exact MAC matches are suggested on the next step; you can change them. Leave empty for inventory only. DNS queries and remote destinations are not supplied by Deco.

telemetry_client_asset.title: Link {client} ({position}/{count})
telemetry_client_asset.description: MAC: {mac}. A suggested asset comes from a saved link or an exact MAC match. IP addresses and names are not used to match. Each asset can have one client link so its meters cannot overwrite each other. No changes are made until the final confirmation.

error.invalid_guid: Enter a user GUID, or leave the field empty.
error.invalid_auth: UteamUP rejected the company API key. Update its credentials and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not load the company's IoT configuration. Check the connection and try again.
error.telemetry_not_allowed: The company API key and its creator need IOT.Environment.Read, IOT.View, Asset.View and AssetType.View.
error.environment_unavailable: Dedicated ingestion is not ready. An active entitlement also needs a healthy HTTPS endpoint. Finish its setup in UteamUP first.
error.no_devices: Choose at least one active existing IoT device with an asset and physical MAC address.
error.no_telemetry_meters: This asset needs active numeric W and cumulative-kWh meter attributes with Allow IoT updates enabled. Add them in UteamUP, then reopen Configure.
error.no_network_meters: This asset needs all five active numeric network meters with the shown units and Allow IoT updates enabled. Add them in UteamUP, then reopen Configure.
error.source_missing: The physical device and its required Home Assistant sources must be registered and linked together.
error.device_mismatch: The selected sources do not belong to this physical device. Check their MAC and source metadata.
error.unit_mismatch: Select registered source entities with the units shown in the form.
error.attribute_mismatch: Select active meter attributes with the shown units belonging to this asset and Allow IoT updates enabled.
error.measured_source_required: Measured readings require a native WiZ socket power sensor and energy from that same sensor. Estimated or unrelated helpers cannot be marked measured.
error.invalid_value: A selected source does not currently contain a valid finite, nonnegative value or online state.
error.unavailable: A required source is unavailable or unknown. Restore it, then reopen Configure.
error.invalid_mapping: Enter a valid device ingestion key and complete the required reading settings.
error.client_setup_not_allowed: The tenant key cannot read or link these assets/types. It needs Asset.View, Asset.Update, AssetType.View and AssetType.Create; ask the tenant administrator to check the key. Existing telemetry settings are retained.
error.client_setup_failed: Could not finish linking clients. Existing settings are retained. Some types or attributes may already have been added; retry reuses them. Check the connection and whether the asset was changed by another user.
error.ambiguous_client_type: Several custom types are named Deco client telemetry. Resolve the duplicate in UteamUP before retrying.
error.invalid_client_selection: Select up to 200 registered Deco clients from this network.
error.client_asset_conflict: Choose an active asset from this tenant that has not already been linked to another selected client.

webhook_url_unavailable.title: UteamUP live events need a public URL
webhook_url_unavailable.description: {title} cannot receive live events because Home Assistant has no external URL, and UteamUP does not deliver to local network addresses. Set up Home Assistant Cloud or an external URL. Until then, the entities update on the refresh interval.

webhooks_not_allowed.title: UteamUP did not allow live events
webhooks_not_allowed.description: {title} could not register a webhook. Webhooks need the Enterprise plan, and the API key's role and its creator need Webhook.Manage. Until then, the entities update on the refresh interval.

telemetry_queue_full.title: UteamUP IoT capture reached its local queue limit
telemetry_queue_full.description: {title} retained already queued data. Some new observations could not be captured; the queue sensor's missed_samples counter records them. Restore delivery or review quarantined observations. Capture resumes when space is available. No older data is silently discarded.

telemetry_blocked.title: A UteamUP IoT device needs delivery attention
telemetry_blocked.description: {title} retained rejected observations and stopped capturing for the affected device. Check the device key, endpoint and meter mapping. Save a rotated key, or choose Retry retained quarantined readings in the integration options after correcting the cause. Original observation bytes and UUIDs are preserved.

telemetry_storage_error.title: UteamUP cannot access its IoT queue
telemetry_storage_error.description: {title} will not send unpersisted readings. Check free disk space and permissions for the integration's .storage/uteamup_telemetry queue. Retain the database while investigating; restoring storage access allows delivery to recover.
